description: A secret read with self.secrets.get() is returned in a JSONResponse for browser JavaScript, next to a Stripe publishable key that belongs in the browser

expected_findings.description: api/checkout.py returns self.secrets.get("ELIGIBILITY_API_SECRET") in the /checkout/config JSONResponse, and the page sends it as a bearer token from the browser, exposing it to every user who opens the page; fix is a SimpleAPI route that calls the eligibility API server-side

must_not_flag.description: STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (a Stripe pk_ publishable key, declared non-sensitive) returned to the browser for Stripe.js
